Subject: Trial signup / interest in reserved GPU for low-latency summarization

Hi Rafael,

We just completed the self-serve signup and ran a couple of tests with Redwood's hosted endpoint. The latency looks promising, but our production needs are different: we expect sustained concurrent usage across ~800 simultaneous end users (short inputs, frequent requests) and need p95 latency under ~250ms for our summarization pipeline.

We're evaluating reserved/dedicated capacity because we can't tolerate noisy-neighbor variance. Would love a short walkthrough of Redwood Dedicated: how reserved GPU pools map to throughput, typical backlog/batching tradeoffs, and options for KV/prefix caching.

Attached is a small sample of our traffic pattern (edgescale-prod-sample-traffic.csv) and an architecture sketch.

Best,
Sophie Ho
Platform Lead, EdgeScale
S: +1 (415) 555-0132

--
Note: happy to do a 30m slot next week (US-PDT mornings preferred).

Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 17:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Trial signup / interest in reserved GPU for low-latency summarization

Thanks Sophie — really appreciate the sample files, that helps a lot.

Quick notes:
- Dedicated is the right place to start for tight p95 SLAs; we can size a reserved GPU pool to your steady-state concurrency and then add burst capacity for spikes.
- For summarization workloads (short inputs, lots of parallel requests) we usually recommend: smaller batch windows, aggressive prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts, and a quantization profile that preserves p95 latency.

I'd like to bring Ben (SE) into the call to walk through throughput/latency tuning and run through a short checklist pre-demo. Lauren (manager) is cc'd for account context.

Proposed 30m slots (PDT):
- Tue Jul 27, 9:30–10:00am
- Tue Jul 27, 11:00–11:30am
- Wed Jul 28, 10:00–10:30am

If none of those work, tell us a couple windows and we'll adapt. I'll also drop our pre-demo checklist (one-pager) in a follow-up.

Thanks,
Rafael

2) Which region do you need reserved capacity in? We have GA in us-west-2 and us-east-1; if you need eu we can discuss latency tradeoffs.

From our side, tentative agenda for 30m:
- 5m: goals & constraints (you)
- 10m: Redwood Dedicated overview (sizing + autoscale behaviors)

I can do the Jul 27 11:00am slot — Rafael, feel free to confirm. I've attached a one-page pre-demo checklist (redwood-pre-demo-checklist.pdf) that covers permissions, sample payloads, and a brief runbook.
